runs.text: Dear Editorial Board of the Environment and Natural Resources Journal,

paragraphs.text: I am writing to formally request the withdrawal of my manuscript titled 'Contrasting Seasonal Rainfall Trends under Predominantly Stable Annual Conditions: Evidence from Trend-Free Pre-Whitening Analysis in Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, Thailand' (Manuscript ID: ENNRJ-TES-26-0292), which was recently evaluated and returned for major revision.

runs.text: I am writing to formally request the withdrawal of my manuscript titled 'Contrasting Seasonal Rainfall Trends under Predominantly Stable Annual Conditions: Evidence from Trend-Free Pre-Whitening Analysis in Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, Thailand' (Manuscript ID: ENNRJ-TES-26-0292), which was recently evaluated and returned for major revision.

paragraphs.text: I sincerely appreciate the time and valuable feedback provided by the editorial team. However, due to current time constraints, I am unable to adequately address all the required revisions within the given timeframe. Therefore, I have decided to withdraw the manuscript from consideration at this time.

word/document.xml: Dear Editorial Board of the Environment and Natural Resources Journal,

I am writing to formally request the withdrawal of my manuscript titled 'Contrasting Seasonal Rainfall Trends under Predominantly Stable Annual Conditions: Evidence from Trend-Free Pre-Whitening Analysis in Prachuap Khiri Khan Province, Thailand' (Manuscript ID: ENNRJ-TES-26-0292), which was recently evaluated and returned for major revision.

I sincerely appreciate the time and valuable feedback provided by the editorial team. However, due to current time constraints, I am unable to adequately address all the required revisions within the given timeframe. Therefore, I have decided to withdraw the manuscript from consideration at this time.
I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you again for your time and consideration.
Office of Water Management and Hydrology, Royal Irrigation Department
